title: SOLAR: Towards Characterizing Subjectivity of Individuals through Modeling Value Conflicts and Trade-offs
reasoning: The paper focuses on characterizing individual subjectivity by modeling moral judgments and value trade-offs. It specifically uses Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values and value pluralism to analyze and predict redditors' judgments on social and moral situations, thereby directly evaluating moral reasoning and ethical value systems in LLMs.
